name: Venomancer: Spider and Beetle Form hit with the weapon's own damage at a 2.0 s swing and ignore disarm
contract: Spider Form 800841 is form 52 and Beetle Form 803183 is form 53; neither sets a swing speed, so both swing every 2.0 s.
In form each hit deals the equipped weapon's own min/max damage plus AP/14 x 2.0, and a weapon swapped in form takes effect at once.
In the CoA world, Heavy Hammer 1510 (10.98-18.3, 2.4 s), Bloodstained Knife 3225 (3.36-5.6, 1.6 s) and Morning Star 2532 (35.08-56.5, 1.9 s) are one-handers without stats.
Against the hammer, the knife moves minimum damage by -7.62 and Morning Star by +24.10; normalizing to the form speed gives -4.95 for the knife and stale damage gives 0.
Battle Shout 47436 raises attack power; minimum damage rises by 2.0/14 = 0.1429 of the gain (a 1.0 s swing gives 0.071, 2.5 s gives 0.179).
Like Druid forms, Spider and Beetle Form ignore Disarm 676: damage in form keeps the weapon, and shifting out while disarmed drops to fist damage.
Shifting in while disarmed restores the weapon's damage, and a direct Spider to Beetle switch keeps it.
Control: Cat Form 768 still ignores the weapon's damage.
